The '''Alarevi system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Gaulus sector/Legends|Gaulus sector]], a part of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of [[Alarevi ale]].<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Alarevi ale]]|system=Alarevi [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Alarevi system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square S-17.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
